title: WordPress REST returns stripped content for Elementor pages
symptoms: post_content lacks the HTML visible on the page
Edits to post_content do not change the live page
cause: Elementor stores the real layout in post meta _elementor_data as a JSON string with escaped slashes. post_content is a stripped copy.
fix: Read and write _elementor_data as an opaque string: back it up, make a targeted substring replacement on the exact stored form, validate that it still parses, and write it back. Then clear the Elementor and page caches.
apply: GET /wp-json/wp/v2/pages/<id>?context=edit&_fields=id,meta (requires _elementor_data registered for REST); replace "url":"\/old\/" with "url":"\/new\/"
